                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n14b:T1090,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The correct answer is Potential Energy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • A stretched rubber band stores energy due to the deformation caused by stretching, which is categorized as potential energy.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Potential energy is the energy that is stored in an object due to its position, configuration, or condition.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In the case of a rubber band, the energy is stored as elastic potential energy, which results from the rubber band being stretched beyond its equilibrium position.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • When the rubber band is released, the stored elastic potential energy is converted into other forms of energy, such as kinetic energy, causing the rubber band to move.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Given:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Height (h) = 50 m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Formula used:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Initial speed (u) = 0 (for any object dropped from a height)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Calculation:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Since the object is dropped, its initial speed u = 0 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ The correct answer is option (2).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "hn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिया गया है:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ऊँचाई (h) = 50 मीटर

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रयुक्त सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रारंभिक गति (u) = 0 (किसी भी वस्तु के लिए जिसे ऊँचाई से गिराया जाता है)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            चूँकि वस्तु को गिराया जाता है, इसलिए इसकी प्रारंभिक गति u = 0 मीटर/सेकंड

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ सही उत्तर विकल्प (2) है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "te": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఇచ్చినవి:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఎత్తు (h) = 50 మీ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ఉపయోగించిన సూత్రం:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ప్రారంభ వేగం (u) = 0 (ఎత్తు నుండి వదిలివేయబడిన ఏ వస్తువుకైనా)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            లెక్క:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            వస్తువును వదిలివేయబడినందున, దాని ప్రారంభ వేగం u = 0 మీ/సె

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ సరైన సమాధానం ఆప్షన్ (2).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "mr": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            दिलेले आहे:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            उंची (h) = 50 मी

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वापरलेले सूत्र:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            प्रारंभिक वेग (u) = 0 (उंचीवरून सोडलेल्या कोणत्याही वस्तूसाठी)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            गणना:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            वस्तू सोडली जात असल्याने, तिचा प्रारंभिक वेग u = 0 मी/से

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ पर्याय (2) योग्य आहे.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "bn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            প্রদত্ত:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            উচ্চতা (h) = 50 মি

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ব্যবহৃত সূত্র:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            প্রাথমিক বেগ (u) = 0 (যেকোনো বস্তু উচ্চতা থেকে ফেললে)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            গণনা:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            যেহেতু বস্তুটি ফেলা হয়েছে, তাই এর প্রাথমিক বেগ u = 0 মি/সে

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ সঠিক উত্তর হলো বিকল্প (2)।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "ml": "", "gu": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            આપેલ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ઉંચાઈ (h) = 50 m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            સૂત્ર:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            પ્રારંભિક ઝડપ (u) = 0 (કોઈપણ ઉંચાઈ પરથી છોડવામાં આવેલી વસ્તુ માટે)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ગણતરી:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            જો કે વસ્તુ છોડવામાં આવે છે, તેથી તેની પ્રારંભિક ઝડપ u = 0 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ સાચો જવાબ વિકલ્પ (2) છે.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "kn": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ನೀಡಲಾಗಿದೆ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಎತ್ತರ (h) = 50 m

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಬಳಸಿದ ಸೂತ್ರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಆರಂಭಿಕ ವೇಗ (u) = 0 (ಯಾವುದೇ ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಒಂದು ಎತ್ತರದಿಂದ ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬೀಳಿಸಿದಾಗ)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ಲೆಕ್ಕಾಚಾರ:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ವಸ್ತುವನ್ನು ಬೀಳಿಸಲಾಗಿರುವುದರಿಂದ, ಅದರ ಆರಂಭಿಕ ವೇಗ u = 0 m/s

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ∴ ಸರಿಯಾದ ಉತ್ತರ ಆಯ್ಕೆ (2).

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n", "ta": "

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            கொடுக்கப்பட்டது:

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            உயரம் (h) = 50 மீ

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            பயன்படுத்தப்படும் சூத்திரம்:
